newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei OMC rises on earnings announcement.
newsitem.headline: Daiei OMC rises on earnings announcement.

text.p: Daiei OMC Inc's shares climbed in early Tuesday afternoon trade as investors bought back the shares following the company's earnings announcement on Monday, brokers said.
Investors decided that there were few negative factors left to dampen the share price further, they said.
As of 0401 GMT, the shares of the consumer credit company were up 50 yen or 22.73 percent at 270, the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Daiei OMC said its parent current profit in the year to February 28, 1997, was 1.32 billion yen against 2.02 billion in the previous year.
